forces.title: Broadening GLP-1 access and indications fuel consumer market expansion.
forces.description: The GLP-1 market is undergoing a structural shift driven by new drug formats (oral semaglutide, Lilly's Foundayo) and expanded indications beyond Type 2 diabetes to include obesity, sleep apnea, MASH, and cardiovascular risk. This, coupled with evolving access mechanisms like cash payments, employer coverage, direct digital platforms, and potential Medicare expansion, transforms GLP-1s into widely accessible consumer health products, significantly growing the IN060703 market.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: GLP-1s fundamentally alter consumer food and supplement choices.
forces.description: GLP-1 usage is causing a significant behavioral shift among consumers, impacting their purchasing habits. Food spending is reprioritized towards fresh produce, protein, and fiber, with reduced consumption of processed foods, sugary drinks, and alcohol. Concurrently, there's a notable increase in demand for targeted supplements (protein, fiber, collagen, peptides, wellness injectables). This creates both challenges for traditional CPG sectors and substantial opportunities for D2C women's health brands and wellness providers within IN060703.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: GLP-1 users drive demand for lifestyle and aesthetic enhancement.
forces.description: The emergence of 'Lifestyle optimization' and 'Aesthetic transformation' as key purchase archetypes among GLP-1 users indicates a strong demand for health and beauty products/services beyond weight loss. This includes increased spending on therapeutic dermatology-like products, specific supplements for hair/skin/nails, and wellness injectables. This trend offers a significant upside for femtech, D2C women's health brands, and longevity clinics catering to holistic well-being and appearance goals.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: Sustained GLP-1 use and re-engagement boost market stability.
forces.description: Despite varying adherence patterns, the majority of GLP-1 users plan continuous use, and a significant portion of lapsed users intend to restart their treatment. This indicates a robust and recurring demand for GLP-1 products in the consumer health market. The commitment to sustained use and re-engagement provides market stability and predictability for manufacturers and associated wellness service providers within the Women's Health & Longevity sector, supporting consistent revenue streams.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: Aging population fuels 'silver economy,' boosting longevity-related consumer demand.
forces.description: Europe is experiencing a significant increase in its over-65 population, with the 'silver economy' projected to represent over 35% of spending by 2030. This demographic shift drives demand for products and services catering to healthy aging and longevity. While primarily discussed in a retail context, this structural change provides substantial opportunities for longevity clinics and D2C women's health brands within IN060703 to develop and market offerings tailored to the needs of this growing senior consumer base.
forces.source_title: Bank of Ireland Retail Convenience H1 2026 Insights and H2 2026 Outlook July 2026

viewpoints.title: GLP-1 consumer market expanding with new formats and indications.
viewpoints.description: BCG observes that the GLP-1 market is evolving across multiple formats and indications, moving beyond traditional prescription. Oral formulations (e.g., Lilly's Foundayo, oral semaglutide) and expanded uses for obesity, sleep apnea, and MASH are broadening the market. Direct-to-consumer digital platforms and increased reimbursement (e.g., Medicare for obesity from 2026) are further expanding consumer access, signaling robust growth for GLP-1s as consumer health products within Women's Health & Longevity.
viewpoints.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

viewpoints.title: GLP-1s fundamentally reshape consumer purchasing across health and lifestyle.
viewpoints.description: BCG identifies that GLP-1 usage is profoundly transforming consumer behavior, leading to shifts in spending patterns. Users exhibit distinct purchase archetypes, influencing food choices towards functional products (protein, fiber) and away from indulgence (salty snacks, alcohol). There's also increased expenditure on targeted supplements (collagen, peptides, wellness injectables) and casual clothing. This transformation creates significant opportunities for D2C women's health brands and wellness providers to adapt to evolving consumer needs.
viewpoints.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

demand_drivers.description: Continued expansion of coverage for GLP-1s, including Medicare for obesity starting 2026 and deepening commercial coverage via employer plans with fewer restrictions.
Increased willingness of physicians to prescribe and consumers to use GLP-1s, driven by lower out-of-pocket costs and improved side-effect management.
Expansion into new segments through novel formats like oral GLP-1s and lower-cost injectables, with assumptions of no major supply constraints.

market_sizing.methodology: BCG analysis, triangulated via sales data, scripts data, and BCG survey data (N=1882) of US adult population. Base case assumes continued reimbursement expansion (Medicare for obesity from 2026), deepening commercial coverage via employer plans, fewer restrictions, increased uptake due to physician adoption, consumer acceptance, lower out-of-pocket costs, side-effect management, and expansion into new segments via new formats (orals, lower-cost injectables) with no major supply constraints.
market_sizing.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

demand_drivers.description: GLP-1 users seek specific nutritional support, leading to increased spending on protein, fiber, and collagen supplements to address dietary changes and potential side effects associated with GLP-1 use.

Users pursuing 'Lifestyle optimization' and 'Aesthetic transformation' purchase archetypes are driving demand for supplements like hair/skin/nails, probiotics, prebiotics, and peptides/wellness injectables.

new_opportunities.description: Opportunities exist for developing supplements specifically designed to meet the unique nutritional needs and holistic well-being goals of GLP-1 users, focusing on protein, fiber, gut health, and cosmetic benefits.
The growth in demand for peptides and other wellness injectables among GLP-1 users presents a nascent market opportunity within the broader aesthetic and longevity treatment space.

market_sizing.methodology: BCG GLP-1 Supplemental Survey, April 2026 (N=1882), analyzing supplement users (n=184). Impact on purchasing behavior reflects average change based on weighted responses across Increase, Decrease, and No change in spending. The analysis covers various supplement categories.
market_sizing.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior
